title: Shawn Michaels vs. Triple H: broken friendship
summary: Michaels returns from a long absence to fight his former friend. Their personal feud continues through title matches and a Hell in a Cell confrontation.

chapters.title: Michaels returns and wins
chapters.result: Michaels defeats Triple H in the unsanctioned match.
chapters.context: The former partners meet in Michaels’ return to major singles competition.

chapters.title: Neither man can answer the count
chapters.result: The Last Man Standing title match ends in a draw; Triple H retains.
chapters.context: The drawn result leaves the long rivalry unresolved.

chapters.title: Triple H wins inside Hell in a Cell
chapters.context: The prolonged feud reaches its major 2004 singles-match finale.
